record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
record.context_brief: Density of non-uniform hyperbolicity in the conservative C^{1+α} setting
record.original_question: Let M be a compact smooth Riemannian manifold, let μ be a measure equivalent to volume on M, let Diff^{1+α}(M, μ) denote the C^{1+α} diffeomorphisms preserving μ, and let H be the subset of those diffeomorphisms that have nonzero Lyapunov exponents on a set of positive μ-measure. Is H dense in Diff^{1+α}(M, μ)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.2. H is dense in Diff1+α(M, µ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a compact smooth Riemannian manifold and let $\mu$ be a Borel probability measure on $M$ that is equivalent to the Riemannian volume. For $\alpha \in (0,1)$, let $\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$ denote the space of $C^{1+\alpha}$ diffeomorphisms of $M$ preserving $\mu$, endowed with the $C^{1+\alpha}$ topology. For a diffeomorphism $f \in \mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$ and a point $x \in M$ where the Oseledets theorem applies, denote by $\chi_1(f,x) \geq \cdots \geq \chi_{\dim M}(f,x)$ its Lyapunov exponents. Define
$$H = \{ f \in \mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu) : \mu(\{x \in M : \chi_i(f,x) \neq 0 \text{ for all } i\}) > 0 \}.$$
Is $H$ dense in $\mathrm{Diff}^{1+\alpha}(M,\mu)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The analogous statement in the $C^1$ topology has been established (Avila–Crovisier–Wilkinson and related works showing $C^1$-density of nonuniform hyperbolicity among $C^r$ volume-preserving diffeomorphisms), but density of $H$ in the stronger $C^{1+\alpha}$ topology appears to remain open: no source found resolving the $C^{1+\alpha}$ density conjecture, and recent surveys still discuss it as a major open problem in non-uniform hyperbolicity.

status_evidence.title: The C^1 density of nonuniform hyperbolicity in C^r conservative diffeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Diffeomorphisms without zero Lyapunov exponents on a set of positive volume are C^1 dense among C^r volume-preserving diffeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: The C^1-density version is known; the C^{1+α}-density version is the natural strengthening that remains open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in the theory of non-uniform hyperbolicity
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 4.2. H is dense in Diff^{1+α}(M,µ).
status_evidence.claim: Stated as an open conjecture in a survey of open problems.
